cues.en: So this little guy I have here is a transistor,
cues.zh: 我手里这个小东西是一个晶体管，

cues.en: and, the schematic symbol for it over here is is this diagram here.
cues.zh: 它的电路符号就是这里这个图。

cues.en: And you can see, just to kinda orient, there's the three leads on the transistor, and those correspond to the three things here. So we've got an emitter,
cues.zh: 大致看一下，晶体管有三个引脚，分别对应这里的三部分：发射极，

cues.en: a base, and a collector. And just to kind of orient ourselves,
cues.zh: 基极和集电极。我们再对应一下，

cues.en: this would be the emitter,
cues.zh: 这个是发射极，

cues.en: the middle lead is the base, and this lead is the collector.
cues.zh: 中间的引脚是基极，这个引脚是集电极。

cues.en: And so that's just kinda how this corresponds to the schematic symbol for it. And what a transistor is, is it's basically a current switch. What that means is that if we establish a current from the base to the emitter in this direction,
cues.zh: 这就是它与原理图符号的对应关系。晶体管本质上就是一个电流开关。这意味着，如果我们让电流沿这个方向从基极流向发射极，

cues.en: that'll switch the transistor on, and the transistor will allow a much larger current to flow from the collector to the emitter.
cues.zh: 就会导通晶体管，从而允许大得多的电流从集电极流向发射极。

cues.en: So what we can do with that is something like this, which is this circuit that we've got set up over here. And, basically what this circuit does is we've got a switch that allows us to complete a circuit that allows current to flow, like I said, from the base to the emitter, from the base to the emitter. So if we close this little switch, push this button,
cues.zh: 利用这一点，我们就能做出类似这样的电路，也就是我们在这边搭建的这个。这个电路的基本原理是，我们用一个开关来接通电路，正如我刚才所说，让电流从基极流向发射极，从基极流向发射极。所以只要闭合这个小开关，按下这个按钮，

cues.en: that establishes
cues.zh: 从而建立起

cues.en: a circuit like this and causes current to flow from the base of the emitter that turns the transistor on.
cues.zh: 这样一个电路，并使电流从发射极基极流过，从而导通晶体管。

cues.en: Once the transistor is turned on then, current then allowed to flow from the collector to the emitter in this direction,
cues.zh: 晶体管导通后，电流就能沿这个方向从集电极流向发射极，

cues.en: and that allows this second part of the circuit to work,
cues.zh: 这样电路的第二部分就能工作了，

cues.en: where current,
cues.zh: 电流

cues.en: will then flow from the battery here,
cues.zh: 会从这里的电池流出，

cues.en: through this resistor, through this, light emitting diode or LED,
cues.zh: 经过这个电阻，再经过这个发光二极管，也就是 LED，

cues.en: which will turn that on and see this light up, and then through the transistor.
cues.zh: 点亮它，你就会看到它亮起来，然后电流再流过晶体管。

cues.en: And then if we aren't putting current from the base to the emitter, then transistor shuts off and so this other part of the circuit will shut off and the LED will shut off.
cues.zh: 然后，如果我们没有把电流从基极送到发射极，晶体管就会关断，电路的这一部分也会断电，LED 就会熄灭。

cues.en: So we can see in the circuit,
cues.zh: 所以我们可以在电路里看到，

cues.en: the first part of the circuit we've got, from the positive voltage rail here, we've got this resistor that goes through the button,
cues.zh: 电路的第一部分，从这边的正电压轨开始，我们有这个电阻，经过按钮，

cues.en: and then into the base of the transistor,
cues.zh: 然后进入晶体管的基极，

cues.en: and then that will allow us to get that first current flowing to turn the transistor on and that'll go back out through the negative terminal here. And once the transistor's on, that'll allow current to flow from the positive rail here, through the resistor, through the LED, into the transistor, through the transistor now that it's on, and then out through this,
cues.zh: 这样就能让第一股电流流动，把晶体管打开，然后电流会从这边的负极端子流回去。一旦晶体管导通，就能让电流从这边的正电压轨流出，经过电阻，经过 LED，进入晶体管，通过已经导通的晶体管，然后从这里流出，

cues.en: this negative rail. So if we push the button,
cues.zh: 这条负电源轨。所以如果我们按下按钮，

cues.en: transistor turns on, and consequently the LED turns on.
cues.zh: 晶体管就会导通，LED 也会随之亮起。

cues.en: Okay. So far so good. Let's take a look at another circuit, which is on the other half of this breadboard
cues.zh: 好，目前一切顺利。我们来看看另一个电路，它位于这块面包板的另一半，

cues.en: here. And in this circuit,
cues.zh: 就在这里。这个电路里，

cues.en: we've got something a little bit different going on. We've got the
cues.zh: 有一点不太一样。我们看到，

cues.en: transistor is is off,
cues.zh: 晶体管是关断的，

cues.en: but with the transistor being off, we have this part of the circuit here, which actually allows
cues.zh: 但晶体管关断时，电路的这一部分实际上允许

cues.en: current to flow through this resistor and then through the LED.
cues.zh: 电流流过这个电阻，再流过 LED。

cues.en: So the LED is actually already on, which you can see right here. So the LED is on right now,
cues.zh: 所以这个 LED 其实已经亮了，大家可以在这里看到。现在 LED 是亮着的，

cues.en: but if we turn the transistor on, then we'll actually
cues.zh: 但如果我们导通晶体管，实际上就会

cues.en: sort of allow current to flow through the transistor here, and that'll lower this, the voltage potential at this node,
cues.zh: 让电流流经这里的晶体管，从而拉低这个节点的电位，

cues.en: and so instead of having a positive voltage here that allows current to flow through the LED, we won't have a voltage differential between
cues.zh: 这样一来，这里就不会再有让电流流过 LED 的正电压，在晶体管导通时，

cues.en: the two parts of the transistor when the transistor is on. And so that'll actually have the effect of turning the LED off.
cues.zh: 晶体管的两端就不会产生电位差。这样实际上就达到了熄灭 LED 的效果。

cues.en: So if we
cues.zh: 所以如果我们

cues.en: do that, we see the LED turns off.
cues.zh: 这么做，就会看到 LED 熄灭。

cues.en: So in this case, we're we're using this transistor as a switch to kind of invert
cues.zh: 这个例子里，我们把这个晶体管当作开关，用来反转

cues.en: the voltage here. So if we look at the voltage here, right now it's zero volts,
cues.zh: 这里的电压。看一下这里的电压，现在是零伏，

cues.en: because this switch is is open
cues.zh: 因为这个开关是断开的，

cues.en: and the LED is seeing, you know, a positive voltage.
cues.zh: 而 LED 两端有正电压。

cues.en: And then if we turn the switch on, we have a positive voltage here, but then we get zero volts differential
cues.zh: 接通开关后，这里有正电压，但 LED 两端的电压差变成了零伏，

cues.en: here across the LED and the LED turns off. And so this this little circuit is called, an inverter.
cues.zh: 所以 LED 熄灭了。这个小电路叫作反相器。

cues.en: And there's, there's actually a symbol for it and that's this little triangle with a circle. And there's a sort of a truth table for the logic, it's pretty simple.
cues.zh: 其实它有个专门的符号，就是这个小三角形加一个圆圈。逻辑上还有一张真值表，挺简单的。

cues.en: If the input is off, the output is on, or if the input is a zero, we kinda use that to represent off,
cues.zh: 如果输入是关闭，输出就是开启；或者说如果输入是 0，我们用这个来表示关闭，

cues.en: the output is on. If the input is on, then the output is off. Pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 输出就是开启。如果输入是开启，那输出就是关闭。非常简单明了。

cues.en: So let's look at some other logic circuits that we can make with transistors. Okay, this next circuit that we'll look at, we've got two transistors,
cues.zh: 那我们来看看其他可以用晶体管搭出来的逻辑电路。好，接下来要看的这个电路，我们有两个晶体管，

cues.en: just kind of this left half of the board here. We've got two transistors,
cues.zh: 就是板子左半边这部分。我们有两个晶体管，

cues.en: and the way it works is we've got these inputs which again are kind of, I haven't drawn the whole circuit out, but we still have this
cues.zh: 它的工作原理是我们有这些输入，同样地，我没把整个电路都画出来，但我们还是有这个

cues.en: resistor coming from the positive rail here through the push button switch and then into the base of the transistor, and so that allows us to put a current through that transistor.
cues.zh: 从正极轨道过来的电阻，经过按钮开关，然后进到晶体管的基极，这样我们就能让电流通过那个晶体管。

cues.en: And we've got two of those. And so what happens is that if both transistors are turned on, then that will complete the circuit through
cues.zh: 我们这里有两个这样的晶体管。这样一来，如果两个晶体管都导通，就会形成一个完整的通路：

cues.en: this resistor here,
cues.zh: 电流穿过这里的这个电阻，

cues.en: and then through this LED, and then through the first transistor, and over here and through the second transistor.
cues.zh: 然后穿过这个 LED，接着流经第一个晶体管，再到这边穿过第二个晶体管。

cues.en: And so if both transistors
cues.zh: 所以，如果两个晶体管

cues.en: are turned on,
cues.zh: 都处于导通状态，

cues.en: then the LED will turn on. And this is a little piece of logic that is called an and gate,
cues.zh: LED 就会亮起。这种简单的逻辑结构被称为“与门”（AND gate），

cues.en: and this
cues.zh: 而这

cues.en: is the truth table for it, this is the symbol that we would use if we were
cues.zh: 是它的真值表，如果我们要绘制

cues.en: drawing a more complex logic circuit. We would actually, instead of drawing all the little transistors, we would just, you know, kind of draw this whole circuit as just an and gate using this symbol, it's kind of rounded on this side and squared
cues.zh: 更复杂的逻辑电路，就会用这个符号。实际上，与其画出所有微小的晶体管，我们直接用这个符号把整个电路简画成一个与门，它这边是圆弧状的，而另一边是平直的

cues.en: off on this side.
cues.zh: 这边是关断的。

cues.en: And the truth table for it says that if a and b are off, then the output is off, and that's kind of what we have now. So both of these are off, I'm not pushing either one, and the output is off.
cues.zh: 它的真值表显示，如果 a 和 b 都是关，那输出就是关，这正是我们目前的状态。这两个都是关的，我哪个都没按，输出也是关。

cues.en: If b is on and a is off, then the output is also off, and we can test that just by pushing the button and the LED doesn't come on.
cues.zh: 如果 b 是开而 a 是关，输出同样是关，我们直接按一下按钮就能验证，LED 并没有亮。

cues.en: Same thing, if a
cues.zh: 同理，如果 a

cues.en: is on and b is off, then the output is also off, we can test that by
cues.zh: 是开而 b 是关，输出也是关，我们可以通过

cues.en: pushing the button here.
cues.zh: 按这里的按钮来测试。

cues.en: But if both of them are on, then the output is on, and that makes sense. If both of these are on, then that completes the circuit all the way through. And so if I push both the buttons, then you can see the LED comes on because we're we're completing the circuit all the way through.
cues.zh: 但如果两个都导通，输出就会导通，这也说得通。如果这两个都导通，整个电路就闭合了。所以如果我同时按下两个按钮，你就能看到 LED 亮了，因为我们把整条电路都接通了。

cues.en: So how about this other circuit over here? It's a little bit
cues.zh: 那这边的另一个电路呢？它稍微有点……

cues.en: I'll show you the circuit diagram first.
cues.zh: 我先给你们看一下电路图。

cues.en: The circuit diagram for this is a little bit different. So we still have two transistors, we still have our LED,
cues.zh: 这个的电路图稍微有点不同。我们依然有两个晶体管，依然有 LED，

cues.en: but they're wired up just a little bit different.
cues.zh: 但它们的接线方式稍微有点不一样。

cues.en: So in this case,
cues.zh: 所以在这种情况下，

cues.en: the transistors are kind of in parallel,
cues.zh: 这些晶体管算是并联的，

cues.en: and so
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: if either of the transistors is on, then the LED would come on, because we can complete the circuit through this transistor or through this transistor.
cues.zh: 只要任意一个晶体管导通，LED 就会亮，因为我们可以通过这个晶体管或这个晶体管构成回路。

cues.en: So if we look at the circuit kinda closely here, we can see that from the positive rail,
cues.zh: 所以如果我们仔细看这里的电路，可以看到从正极轨道出发，

cues.en: we come through this resistor and then through the LED, and then we can go through this first transistor, so from the,
cues.zh: 经过这个电阻，再经过 LED，然后可以走这个第一个晶体管，所以从这个，

cues.en: you know, the collector here to the emitter,
cues.zh: 你知道的，这里的集电极到发射极，

cues.en: or we can actually kinda come over to this transistor
cues.zh: 或者我们其实可以走到这个晶体管，

cues.en: in through the
cues.zh: 从

cues.en: collector and out through the emitter. And then so if either of these transistors is on,
cues.zh: 集电极进，从发射极出。那么只要这两个晶体管中任意一个导通，

cues.en: then the LED will be on. So we can test that out. So if we turn this one on, it comes on. If we test turn this one on, it comes on as well.
cues.zh: LED 就会亮。我们可以测试一下。把这个导通，它就亮了。再试试把这个导通，它也会亮。

cues.en: And so this is something called an OR gate,
cues.zh: 这就是所谓的 OR 门，

cues.en: which makes sense if this or this is on, then the output is on. And so this is the truth table for it. So if both are off, the output is off, which is what we see here.
cues.zh: 如果这个或那个打开，输出就会打开，这很容易理解。这是它的真值表。如果两个都关闭，输出就关闭，就像我们在这里看到的这样。

cues.en: But if one of them is on, then the output's on. If the other one is on, the output's also on. And also if both of them are on, because then that'll just complete the circuit either way, and of course either way current will flow, and so it'll be on. So if we push both buttons you can see it's on. So either way or both,
cues.zh: 但只要其中一个打开，输出就会打开。另一个打开时，输出也会打开。两个都打开也一样，因为无论怎样都会接通电路，电流自然会流过，输出就会打开。我们按下两个按钮，可以看到它亮了。所以不管按哪一个，还是两个都按，

cues.en: it doesn't matter. It'll it'll turn on.
cues.zh: 都没关系，它都会打开。

cues.en: So you can see here we've got two different circuits, they're very similar, very similar, but
cues.zh: 你可以看到，这里有两个不同的电路，它们非常相似，非常相似，但是

cues.en: slightly different operation. One is an and operation, the other is an or operation.
cues.zh: 运算方式略有不同。一个是与运算，另一个是或运算。

cues.en: So let's take a look at something a little bit
cues.zh: 那我们来看一个稍微

cues.en: more complicated. So this is,
cues.zh: 更复杂一点的。这就是，

cues.en: I've a different board here, different circuit, and let me just
cues.zh: 我这里换了一块板子，一个不同的电路，我先来

cues.en: power this up. So this, we've got actually five transistors in this circuit,
cues.zh: 给它通上电。这个电路里其实有五个晶体管，

cues.en: and
cues.zh: 并且

cues.en: it basically the same kind of idea here. We've got two inputs that we can, you know, in this case turn on and off with these little push button switches and we have got an output over here which is this LED.
cues.zh: 基本原理其实差不多。我们有两个输入端，可以用这些小按键开关来开闭，这边还有一个输出端，也就是这个 LED。

cues.en: And what we've built is what's called an exclusive or gate or an XOR gate. And it's similar to the or gate which is, you know, it's off if both A and B are off, and it's on if A or B is on, but
cues.zh: 我们构建的这个东西叫做异或门，也就是XOR门。它和或门很相似，或门是这样的：当A和B都关闭时它关闭，当A或B开启时它开启，但是

cues.en: what's different is that it's off if a and b are on.
cues.zh: 不同之处在于，当A和B都开启时它会关闭。

cues.en: And so we can we can actually kinda see that operation, so right now it's off because neither of them are on. But if we if we turn on a, the output is on.
cues.zh: 所以我们其实可以看到这个操作，现在它是关闭的，因为两者都没有开启。但如果我们开启A，输出就会开启。

cues.en: And if we turn on b, then the output is on. But if we turn on both at the same time,
cues.zh: 如果我们开启B，那么输出也会开启。但如果我们同时开启两者，

cues.en: the output goes off.
cues.zh: 输出就会关闭。

cues.en: And to kinda understand how that works,
cues.zh: 为了大致理解它是怎么工作的，

cues.en: I've got the
cues.zh: 我拿到了

cues.en: circuit diagram for what's built here, and you can see that if we just look at this part over here, it looks a lot like the or gate,
cues.zh: 这里搭建的电路图，你可以看到，如果只看这边的这部分，它看起来很像或门，

cues.en: because we've got the five volt source going through our resistor,
cues.zh: 因为5伏电源经过电阻，

cues.en: through the LED, and that's what's going on here. So we've five volt source going through the resistor, through the LED, and into
cues.zh: 经过LED，这就是这里发生的情况。所以5伏电源经过电阻，经过LED，然后进入

cues.en: either of these transistors,
cues.zh: 这两个晶体管中的任意一个，

cues.en: so it can go through either of these transistors,
cues.zh: 所以它可以经过这两个晶体管中的任意一个，

cues.en: and then the inputs for those transistors are the a and b, so these yellow wires come over here and then jumper over to the switches.
cues.zh: 而这些晶体管的输入就是A和B，所以这些黄色导线延伸到这里，然后跳接到开关上。

cues.en: So if either this or this is on, then that'll complete the circuit at least through to this point.
cues.zh: 所以，只要这个或这个接通，电路至少会在这里形成通路。

cues.en: And so in the or gate, we just had this connected directly to ground, and so if either this or this were on, then that would complete the circuit all the way to ground. But in this case, in order to get to ground, we've gotta turn this transistor on too.
cues.zh: 在或门里，我们把这个直接接地了，所以只要这个或这个接通，电路就会一直通到地线。但这个例子里，要接地的话，还得把这个晶体管也打开。

cues.en: Otherwise,
cues.zh: 否则，

cues.en: you know, we've got a five volt sort of connected back to five volts and there's no voltage potential difference between five and five, so the LED is off.
cues.zh: 你看，五伏电压接回了五伏，两边没有电压差，所以 LED 不亮。

cues.en: So in order for this OR gate to work essentially,
cues.zh: 所以为了让这个或门正常工作，

cues.en: this transistor has to be on.
cues.zh: 这个晶体管必须导通。

cues.en: And that transistor is actually normally on, right, because we've got this connected right to five volts. We've got current flowing,
cues.zh: 而这个晶体管其实平时是导通的，对吧，因为这里直接接了 5 伏。电流会

cues.en: you know, from the base to the emitter. So this will normally be on unless
cues.zh: 从基极流向发射极。所以它通常处于导通状态，除非

cues.en: unless a and b are on. If a and b are on, then
cues.zh: 除非 A 和 B 都导通。如果 A 和 B 都导通，那么

cues.en: this
cues.zh: 这个

cues.en: node here is then gonna be connected to ground, that'll turn off this transistor. So if a and b are on, then this transistor is
cues.zh: 这里的节点就会接地，从而关断这个晶体管。所以如果 A 和 B 都导通，这个晶体管就会

cues.en: turned off.
cues.zh: 被关断。

cues.en: And if this transistor is turned off,
cues.zh: 如果这个晶体管关掉了，

cues.en: then
cues.zh: 那么

cues.en: this or gate essentially doesn't work.
cues.zh: 这个或门基本上就不工作了。

cues.en: Which is kind of what we wanna do, right? If a and b are on, we don't wanna really do the same thing as the or gate, we just want the output to be off.
cues.zh: 这正是我们想要的效果，对吧？如果a和b都开启，我们并不想执行或门的功能，我们只是想让输出关闭。

cues.en: So that
cues.zh: 所以

cues.en: is essentially what's going on here, and so that allows us to build you know from, you know it takes us five transistors to do it, but it lets us build this other logic element which is XOR gate, and so again we can see it work if we have A on, it comes on, if we have B on, it comes on, but if we do both at the same time,
cues.zh: 这基本上就是这里发生的情况，这样一来我们就能构建，你知道，虽然需要五个晶体管，但它让我们能构建另一个逻辑元件，也就是异或门，同样我们可以看到它的工作方式：如果A开启，它就开启；如果B开启，它也开启；但如果两者同时开启，

cues.en: it's not on, and of course if they're both off then the output is off as well.
cues.zh: 它就不会开启，当然如果两者都关闭，输出也会关闭。

cues.en: And so these are just a couple of different, gates that you can build with, transistors, and here's actually kind of a whole list of different ones. So we saw, you know, the AND gate, the OR gate, we just saw the XOR gate,
cues.zh: 这些只是用晶体管能构建的几种不同门电路，这里其实还有一整份不同门电路的清单。我们看到了 AND 门、OR 门，刚刚又看了 XOR 门，

cues.en: and we're of course looking at the inverter here. There's also,
cues.zh: 当然这里还有反相器。另外，

cues.en: you can make a buffer. Guess this is actually kind of the first thing we made with the transistor, which is the input was on, then the output was on, the input was off, the output was off. Not very exciting, but it can be useful.
cues.zh: 你还可以做一个缓冲器。猜这其实是我们用晶体管做的第一个东西，输入开，输出就开，输入关，输出就关。不算多有趣，但挺有用。

cues.en: And there's a couple others that we could also make that we didn't look at, which are the
cues.zh: 还有另外几个我们也能做出来，不过前面没讲到，比如

cues.en: not and or NAND, the not or, and the not XOR or the XNOR it's called. And these are basically
cues.zh: 与非门、或非门，还有异或非门，也叫同或门。它们基本上

cues.en: the same as the AND gate but the output is inverted. And actually if you look at the symbol, you have this little little bubble on the output there, which just means that the output is inverted.
cues.zh: 和与门一样，只是输出取反了。其实看符号就能发现，输出端有个小圆圈，这表示输出取反了。

cues.en: And so it's the... Basically the exact opposite. You know, the XNOR is the opposite of the XOR,
cues.zh: 所以它基本上完全相反。你看，异或非门和异或门相反，

cues.en: the NOR is the opposite of the OR, and so on. So you can build any of these with, with a few transistors,
cues.zh: 或非门和或门相反，其他门也是如此。用几个晶体管就能搭出这些门，

cues.en: and then, of course, you can take these logic gates and then build more complex circuits that allow you to do arithmetic or store values in a in a memory and other things that allow you to to build a computer.
cues.zh: 然后，当然，你还可以用这些逻辑门搭建更复杂的电路，用来做算术运算、在内存中存储数值，以及实现其他功能，最终组成一台计算机。
